Title: Generally Available: Azure Ultra Disk Price Reduction in Central US

Body.Content:
Ultra Disks are the most performant block storage option for Azure virtual machines offering consistent low sub-millisecond latency, extremely high performance. This makes Ultra disk ideal for a broad spectrum of the most demanding enterprise production workloads, such as SAP HANA, top-tier databases, and transaction-heavy systems that require the highest levels of performance. 

To support customers running these mission-critical workloads more cost-effectively, we are reducing Ultra Disk pricing in Central US. The new pricing is effective on August 1, 2025. See the table below for details.

Learn more:  

  • Read about Ultra Disk. 
  • For more information about Ultra Disk Storage pricing, visit the Azure Managed Disks pricing page. 
*Price is based on 730 hours per month.

​**: Exact Ultra Disk cost % saving will be based on customer's Ultra Disk capacity, IOPS and throughput configuration in the corresponding region. The estimated cost saving % is calculated based on observed common customer usage.
